title: Last Set, After Hours
description: A saxophonist plays with his eyes closed in a smoky bar, light slicing through the blinds while a lone patron listens from the shadows.
alt: Black-and-white image of a man in a suit playing saxophone in a dim bar while a man in a hat sits at the counter.

title: The Visitor in the Pines
description: Deep in a moonlit forest, a young man stands frozen as a pale, glowing figure drifts among the trees ahead of him.
alt: A young man stands in a dark blue forest facing a glowing white ghostly figure on a rocky slope.

title: Lovers
description: Two slender figures lean forehead to forehead, one washed in cobalt and one in saffron, their restless ink lines tangling where they meet.
alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of two thin figures, one blue and one orange, touching foreheads.

title: The Road Not Taken
description: A man in a dark coat and bowler hat pauses where a golden woodland path divides, autumn birches blazing on every side.
alt: Impressionist painting of a man in a black coat and hat standing at a fork in a path through yellow autumn trees.

title: Goblins at Moonrise
description: Under a huge pale moon, a band of pointy-hatted goblins raids a cabbage patch beside a thatched cottage, making off with pumpkins.
alt: Pen and ink illustration of small elves with pointed hats carrying pumpkins through a garden beside a thatched hut under a full moon.

title: Sun Hat, Red Lips
description: Fine pen lines and flat color shape a freckled young woman glancing sideways from under a stitched sun hat, cool and quietly confident.
alt: Line illustration of a young woman with long dark wavy hair, red lips, a black tank top, and a wide white sun hat.

title: Polka Dots and Attitude
description: Bold red eyeshadow, a blunt black bob, and a chunky polka-dot turtleneck give this sideways glance a playful, unimpressed swagger.
alt: Illustration of a woman with a black bob, red eyeshadow, freckles, a yellow hoop earring, and a red polka-dot turtleneck sweater.

title: The Cracked Smile
description: Porcelain skin splits into turquoise flakes around piercing blue eyes and a red grin, making this sly, weathered face both elegant and unsettling.
alt: Close-up portrait of a man whose face looks like cracked white porcelain peeling to turquoise, with red lips and blue eyes.

title: Bioluminescent Bloom
description: Fine glowing filaments fan out like a sea creature's crown around a calm young woman, sparking with points of violet, teal, and amber light.
alt: Portrait of a woman with blue eyes wearing a headdress of thin glowing fibers in teal, pink, and orange.

title: Held Close
description: Scratchy sepia lines circle a woman and a young girl locked in a tender embrace, eyes closed, as if the drawing itself were holding them.
alt: Sepia ink sketch of a woman hugging a young girl, both with eyes closed, drawn with loose overlapping lines.

title: Route 66, Winter Dusk
description: Thick, cold brushstrokes lay snow across an empty highway, where a lone filling station's amber window glows beneath a Route 66 sign.
alt: Painting of a small white gas station with a lit window beside a snowy road and a Route 66 sign at dusk.

title: Kitchen Dancing
description: Barefoot on the tile, a couple sways forehead to forehead in a warm, lived-in kitchen while steam curls up from the stove.
alt: A man and a woman in T-shirts and jeans dance closely in a dimly lit kitchen at night.

title: Another Margarita
description: A sunburned man in a Hawaiian shirt eyes the camera from a thatched beach bar, margarita in hand and neon glowing overhead.
alt: A man in a red floral shirt sits at a tiki bar by the ocean with a margarita, while a woman and a bartender stand behind him.

title: Nevermore
description: A towering raven perches on a pedestal in a candlelit study, while its gaunt host slumps in a velvet chair among stacks of old books.
alt: A large black raven on a stone pedestal in a dark library, with a figure seated in a purple chair by a lamp.

title: The God of Thunder, Retired
description: A wild-bearded old man in slippers and a cardigan sulks in his armchair as lightning cracks outside, a golden bolt kept under glass like a trophy.
alt: An elderly man with a long white beard sits in an armchair in slippers beside a cane and a lamp, with lightning visible through the window.

title: Freckles and Wildflowers
description: Paint splatters, sketch lines, and pressed blooms collide across a close-up face with plum lips and storm-gray eyes, framed by a sweeping black hat brim.
alt: Mixed-media illustration of a woman's face with freckles, gray eyes, and plum lipstick, with flowers and paint marks around her.

title: Collage in Bloom
description: Glossy lips, a freckled flush, and a cascade of painted poppies and lilies blend into a loose, collage-like fashion study.
alt: Mixed-media illustration of a woman with dark hair, freckles, and glossy plum lips, surrounded by painted flowers and a striped collar.

title: The Pomegranate
description: A girl sleeps beneath a pale blue quilt on a winter night while a silhouette waits in the bright doorway, fruit resting on the nightstand.
alt: Oil painting of a girl asleep in bed at night, with a figure standing in a lit doorway and fruit and a soda can on the bedside table.

title: Live on the Bandstand
description: Strings of bulbs glow over a sharply suited combo mid-song, the front man crooning as the crowd watches in silhouette from the dark.
alt: Flat retro illustration of five men in dark suits performing on a stage with bass, guitar, drums, and a microphone in front of an audience.

title: Village in the Woods
description: Patterned trees in rust, teal, and gold rise like lanterns around a cluster of narrow houses, their windows glowing against a starry black sky.
alt: Folk-art illustration of colorful round and pointed trees surrounding tall narrow houses with lit windows at night.

title: The Porch Swing
description: An elderly couple leans together on a hanging swing, eyes closed in contentment, while a small orange bird keeps them company.
alt: Painting of an old man with round glasses and an old woman with white hair sitting close together on a swing, with an orange bird beside them.

title: Mother's Remedies
description: Herbs, seeds, a steaming cup, and a worn knife sit on a rough table by a frosted window, a ringed and weathered hand resting nearby.
alt: Dark still life of a wooden table with a potted plant, a cup, black seeds, a knife, a candle, and an elderly hand on a cloth.

title: Evening in Red Gloves
description: A sleek column of black silk and crimson opera gloves stands out against a pale oval, as elegant and graphic as a vintage couture poster.
alt: Fashion illustration of a slim woman in a long strapless black gown and red gloves standing before a large white oval on a dark background.

title: The Dove-Grey Gown
description: Every ruffle and pleat of a dove-grey day dress is traced in fine engraved line, finished with a feathered hat and a rose-pink shawl.
alt: Victorian fashion engraving of a woman in a layered gray dress with a wide hat and a pink shawl standing on a garden terrace.

title: The Pirate King
description: Eye patch, tangled hair, and an embroidered black coat mark this weathered captain, who stands on his storm-gray deck as if daring the sea.
alt: A bearded man with an eye patch and an ornate black coat stands on the deck of a sailing ship with the ocean behind him.

title: Enthroned
description: Sprawled on a gilded throne in ripped denim and gold chains, a sunglasses-wearing queen holds court as powdered courtiers swoon and banknotes scatter at her feet.
alt: Baroque-style painting of a woman in sunglasses, ripped jeans, and gold chains lounging on a red throne, surrounded by women in eighteenth-century dresses and money.

title: Couture in Ink
description: Loose black washes and splashes of scarlet sketch a model in a strapless sheath and long gloves, poised mid-stride with effortless cool.
alt: Ink fashion sketch of a woman with short dark hair in a strapless dark dress and long red gloves on a white background.

title: The Gothic Bride
description: A bride with long auburn curls, cat-eye glasses, and a tiny skull clip smiles softly, holding dusky roses while a porcelain pup keeps watch.
alt: Stylized 3D portrait of a smiling woman with long wavy hair and glasses in a lace dress holding pink roses, with a white dog figure beside her.

title: Breton Stripes
description: Tousled hair, round glasses, and a stippled beard give this upward-gazing man a thoughtful, slightly dreamy air, set off by a crisp striped shirt.
alt: Flat illustration of a man with messy dark hair, round glasses, and a beard looking up, wearing a navy and white striped shirt.

title: Fries in Pastel
description: Bathed in candy pinks and color-block blues, a girl with a lilac bob nibbles a fry over a spread of burgers and a striped soda cup.
alt: Pastel illustration of a young woman with a pink bob eating a french fry at a table with burgers, fries, and a drink.

title: Red Line Over the Charles
description: A red train glides over a stone-arched bridge as swirling thread-and-paper clouds in coral, teal, and gold roll over the city and sailboats below.
alt: Textile and paper-quilling artwork of a red train crossing an arched stone bridge over a river with sailboats, under swirling colorful clouds.

title: Boston in Thread
description: Coiled thread and rolled paper turn the Boston skyline into a tactile tapestry, with sailboats on the Charles and trees blooming in coral and gold.
alt: Textile and paper-quilling artwork of a city skyline across a river with sailboats, framed by swirling colorful trees and clouds.

title: Heffalump Country
description: Towering pines frame a huge vermilion sun as a tiny bear pauses on the forest path, small and curious in a very big wood.
alt: Woodblock-style print of a pine forest with a large orange sun and a small bear standing on a path.

title: Route 66, Last Light
description: Fiery sunset streaks and thick palette-knife texture surround a roadside filling station, its red pumps glowing beside a turquoise vintage sedan.
alt: Impressionist painting of a small white gas station with red pumps, a Route 66 sign, and a turquoise classic car at sunset.

title: Island of Autumn
description: A tiny island of blazing New England foliage floats on still water, mirrored perfectly beneath misty, blue-gray mountains.
alt: A small island of orange, yellow, and red trees reflected in a calm lake, with fog-covered mountains behind.

title: Mother Cat and Kittens
description: Ochre, cream, and burnt orange shapes nest a mother cat and her two kittens together, all eyes closed, over a collage of faded book pages.
alt: Folk-art painting of a large stylized cat curled around two kittens on a background of old printed pages.

title: Harlequin in Pearls
description: Checkerboard diamonds, a pearl-encrusted cap, and painted lips give this porcelain-skinned harlequin an eerie, hypnotic beauty.
alt: Close-up of a doll-like woman with a two-tone bob, diamond face paint, checkered lips, and a jeweled harlequin hat.

title: Holiday Dinner, Uneasy Company
description: Bulbous noses, sour looks, and a roast bird gather around a wobbly table against mustard walls in this gleefully grotesque family caricature.
alt: Caricature illustration of an awkward family dinner with three older adults and a child seated at a table with a roast bird and wine.

title: The Vampyre
description: Candlelight floods a canopied bed where a man lies stricken while a shrouded figure leans in from the moonlit dark beyond.
alt: Dark oil painting of a man lying pale in a bed with gold curtains as a ghostly hooded figure reaches toward him, with a church spire outside.

title: The Public Garden in Snow
description: Swans glide beneath a little arched bridge as snow drifts over Boston's Public Garden, where lamplit paths fill with strollers and their dogs.
alt: Folk-art illustration of a snowy park at night with a pond, swans, a small stone bridge, lampposts, and people walking dogs.

title: Snowfall on the Village
description: Tall, narrow houses in brick red, mustard, and teal huddle beneath frosted, dotted trees as a quiet path winds up through fresh snow.
alt: Folk-art illustration of colorful narrow houses with snowy roofs and lit windows among round patterned trees on a starry night.

title: Across the Café Table
description: Chins in hands, a dark-haired young man and a blonde in a red beret lock eyes over coffee, warm lamplight wrapping the moment in a soft glow.
alt: Animated-style illustration of a young man and a young woman in a red beret gazing at each other across a café table.

title: The Foreman
description: Hard hat on and blueprints in hand, a bearded foreman points skyward from the scaffolding as red cranes rise over a city under construction.
alt: Poster-style illustration of a construction worker in a hard hat and orange vest holding plans and pointing up, with cranes behind him.

title: All Souls' Night
description: By moonlight, a bandaged figure smokes alone beside two glasses of golden wine, a gothic tower glowing in the window behind him.
alt: Drawing of a mummy wrapped in bandages smoking at a table with two glasses of wine, with a lit gothic tower and moon outside.

title: Fishing by Moonlight
description: Two old friends sit in camp chairs by a crackling fire, a fishing rod propped between them, as a golden moon spills across the lake.
alt: Illustration of two men in hats sitting in folding chairs beside a campfire at a lake at night under a large yellow moon.

title: Night Drive into Boston
description: A low silver coupe sweeps along the highway toward the city, where tall towers glint under a full moon and a coral band of dusk.
alt: Retro poster illustration of a sports car on a curving highway heading toward a city skyline with tall glass towers under a full moon.

title: The Weathered Gaze
description: Every crease and crack of a grizzled face is etched in copper light, his steady, cold blue stare cutting through the darkness.
alt: Extreme close-up of an older man with long gray hair, a beard, deep wrinkles, and blue eyes resting his chin on his hands.

title: A Chilly Night
description: A pale woman flings open a window onto a moonlit churchyard, where faint figures seem to drift among the crooked headstones.
alt: Black-and-white engraving of a woman in a white gown opening a window toward a graveyard under a bright moon.

title: The Haunted House
description: Firelight warms a gray stone hall where a family sits in silence, unaware of the translucent figures gathering at the hearth.
alt: Oil painting of women and children seated in a stone room with arched windows, with faint ghostly figures near the fireplace.

title: Dusk in Autumn
description: A small child in a nightgown sits on the windowsill watching a crescent moon rise over amber hills, the stove glowing warmly behind.
alt: Watercolor illustration of a child sitting on a windowsill looking out at autumn hills and a crescent moon, with a wood stove and small toys in the room.

title: Blue and Saffron Embrace
description: Thick strokes of cobalt and saffron wrap a mother and child into one shape, her head bowed tenderly over the little one asleep against her.
alt: Painting in bright blue and orange of a woman in a headscarf holding a sleeping child close.

title: The Fox and the Red Balloon
description: Drawn in fine graphite, a dapper fox in a long coat and cap strolls off with a single red balloon, the only color on the page.
alt: Pencil drawing of a fox wearing a coat, cap, and red scarf holding a red balloon, with a pencil lying on the paper.

title: A Marshmallow World
description: A young couple strolls hand in hand through a candy-colored winter where smiling snowballs, cone-shaped pines, and a red sun brighten the snow.
alt: Retro illustration of a man and a woman walking through snow among giant smiling snowballs and stylized trees under a red sun.

title: The Little Witch
description: Perched on a windowsill with her broom, a wispy-haired little witch grins at the full moon beside a startled ginger cat and a pumpkin.
alt: Storybook illustration of a small smiling witch in a pointed hat sitting on a ledge with a broom, an orange cat, and a pumpkin under a full moon.

title: Crown of Blossoms
description: Wreathed in white star-shaped flowers, a freckled, flushed young woman with long golden hair gazes out from a dark, blooming garden.
alt: Illustration of a young woman with long blonde hair and blue eyes wearing a crown of white flowers, surrounded by blossoms.

title: The Black Dog
description: In one panel, a giant black dog looms over five men on a moonlit road. In the other, a woman waits in a lit doorway while red eyes watch from the dark.
alt: Two painted panels: a huge black dog with red eyes towering over five men on a road, and a woman in red standing in the doorway of a small house at night.

title: Immortal Bird
description: A black bird flies from a small white moon, and a ribbon of white dots pours from its beak like music. The bird is both the nightingale and the musician.
alt: Stylized painting of a black bird flying past a full moon above red and grey patterned hills and a small white cottage with a red door.

title: The Flying Piranha
description: A red piranha with sharp teeth floats inside a tall box of blue curtains under a full moon. At the lower right, a small grey dodo watches the fish.
alt: Painting of a red fish with sharp teeth coming out of blue curtains on a box-shaped stage at night, with a small grey dodo standing nearby.

title: Summer Has Gone
description: Through an open door, a flooded autumn field lies under round grey clouds, and small birds fly out of them. In front, a thin fox licks a wounded paw beside large purple turnips.
alt: Collage-style painting of an orange fox licking its paw beside an open door, with a cabbage, a beet, a grey sea, and round pale shapes in the sky.

title: The First Fish with Feet
description: A primitive fish with four legs crawls up a stone stairway out of the sea. A pale moon hangs over teal water, and silver pampas grass frames the scene.
alt: Illustration of a large teal lizard-like creature crawling down striped steps among tall pale grasses under a gold moon by the sea.

title: The Ants Enter
description: A trail of black ants comes down a blue kitchen wall in a long S-curve and crosses the table. Through the open window, a golden field with red poppies stretches toward blue hills.
alt: Painting of a blue room where a winding line of black ants comes down the wall onto a breakfast table with plates, cups, and a yellow lamp.

title: Silver Grass at the Shore
description: Tall silver grass bends across a teal night sky, framing a small moon and a lone figure on a pebbled shore far below.
alt: Stylized painting of tall pale grass plumes arching over a teal sky, with a small white moon and a tiny figure standing on a stony shoreline.

title: Married to the Mud
description: A sacred lotus rises from dark mud at the edge of a mountain lake under a hazy golden moon. A white bloom and a pink bloom stand among wide blue-green leaves.
alt: Soft watercolour of a white lotus and a pink lotus with large round leaves beside a lake, with blue mountains and a glowing gold disc behind.

title: Here to Stay
description: A spotted lanternfly spreads its wings like an emblem on a hot pink ground. Spiral circles drift around it, and the insect looks calm and permanent.
alt: Hand-coloured print of a large insect seen from above, with pale blue black-spotted wings and orange underwings, on a pink background with spiral circles and fine scratched lines.

title: Late Night at the Keyboard
description: Lit only by his screen, a gray-haired man in a loosened red tie types into the night, coffee cooling beside him and a cat asleep on the desk.
alt: Painted illustration of an older man with glasses and a pencil in his mouth typing at a computer at night, with a cat asleep beside him.

title: Little Black Dress
description: Quick ink-blue strokes sketch a poised woman in a strapless gown, pearls, and long gloves, with a single flash of red at her hands.
alt: Fashion illustration of a woman with short dark hair in a strapless black dress, a pearl necklace, and long gloves on a navy background.

title: Two Pennies' Worth
description: A kindly ice cream man leans from his truck to hand a strawberry cone to a hopeful boy, while a sunny small-town street bustles behind them.
alt: Illustration of an older man in a white cap leaning out of an ice cream truck to hand a cone to a young boy in a striped shirt.

title: A Second First Meeting
description: A grey-haired man and a woman with sea-blue hair stare at each other in comic disbelief across one piña colada, while rain falls on the beach and a paper umbrella shelters them.
alt: Painted illustration of a grey-haired man holding a newspaper and a blue-haired woman under a paper umbrella, facing each other across a piña colada on a beach.

title: The Shot
description: A basketball player leaps toward the hoop in a few heavy black strokes. The ball rests on his fingertips at the instant of release, and loose lines trail from his body.
alt: Black ink line drawing of a basketball player leaping toward a hoop with the ball raised in one hand.

title: Black Coffee
description: A woman sits in the dark at her kitchen window as steam rises from the kettle. Dawn lights a long empty road down the valley, and one small bird flies away.
alt: Silhouette of a woman at a window looking out at orange mountains at dawn, with a winding road and a small bird in the sky.

title: So Lonesome
description: Under a purple night sky, a full moon slips behind a cloud. A great red tree drops its leaves as a train crosses the field and one tiny figure waits below with a lantern.
alt: Woodblock-style print of a large red tree under a full moon, with a train crossing a golden field and a small figure on a bench.

title: Winter Church
description: A single white church stands on a snowy hill among tall black trees with canopies of blue and violet frost. Its windows glow gold, and a tiny figure walks up the path.
alt: Stylised print of a white church with a tall black steeple on a snowy hill, surrounded by tall dark trees and falling snow.

title: Leaves Like Glass
description: Autumn leaves in blue, violet, and coral hang from a dark twig. Fine ink lines crack each leaf into small panes, like stained glass.
alt: Watercolour of a twig with blue, purple, and orange leaves divided by fine dark ink lines on white paper.

title: Friends with Ghosts
description: A Two-Spirit person looks back over one shoulder. The ghost of their mother stands close behind, joined to them by a red thread.
alt: Pencil drawing of a young person with a dark braid in a black shirt looking back over one shoulder. An older woman drawn in red lines stands behind them, joined by a red thread with a bow.

title: Waiting for the Light
description: A young woman with a dark bob looks up through a rain-beaded window. Orange lamps glow in the room behind her.
alt: Oil painting of a young woman with a dark bob and blue eyes looking up behind a rain-spotted window. She wears a teal jacket, and orange lamps glow behind her.

title: You Go to My Head
description: A singer steps into the spotlight on amateur night. Music notes curl around her head while the pianist plays.
alt: Art Deco illustration of a singer at a vintage microphone in a white spotlight. A pianist plays at the right, and audience silhouettes sit at the left.

title: Behind the Blue Bars
description: A young woman looks up through a rain-wet window. Thick blue bars cross her face, and warm orange lamps glow behind her.
alt: Oil painting of a young woman with a short dark bob looking up through a window. Thick teal window bars cross her face, and orange lamps glow behind her.

title: September Tomatoes
description: A woman pulls a dying tomato plant from the garden. A few blossoms still open, and the wind swirls above her like an old song.
alt: Collage-style painting of a woman in a patchwork red dress pulling a plant out of the soil by its roots. Red tomatoes lie on the ground.

title: Drenched in Purple
description: A person sits on a bed in a purple-lit room. Outside, a magenta car drives down the road and back again.
alt: Purple linocut print of a person sitting on a bed and looking out an open door. A magenta car drives on a winding road under bare trees.

title: Double, Double
description: Three grinning witches lean over a bubbling cauldron outside a stone cottage. Green steam rises into the moonlit sky.
alt: Painting of three grinning old witches in pointed hats leaning over a steaming black cauldron. A stone cottage and red autumn leaves surround them under a crescent moon.

title: Theme in Yellow
description: Children hold hands and dance in a ring around a glowing jack-o'-lantern. A harvest moon rises over the misty cornfield.
alt: Painting of children in coats holding hands in a ring around a glowing jack-o'-lantern. A large moon and a bare tree are behind them, and pumpkins lie in the foreground.

title: Every Leaf Speaks Bliss
description: A woman opens her arms under an autumn tree at nightfall. Leaves and the first snow fall around her, and a last red rose blooms nearby.
alt: Illustration of a smiling woman in a black coat and orange scarf with her arms open on a hill path at night. Orange leaves and snow fall around her.

title: Looking Up
description: A rocket rises from its launch tower on a column of white fire. Beside it, a woman's profile pieced from newsprint and colored paper scraps lifts her gaze to watch it go.
alt: Collage illustration of a rocket launching beside a tall red launch tower, with a large human face in profile made of torn paper and newsprint on the right.

title: Diamond Sky
description: A dancer spins on a glittering blue shore at dawn, a tambourine in her hand. Rings of golden sparkle rise above her, and diamond-shaped stars glint in the deep blue sky.
alt: Fantasy beach at dawn with a dancer in a long dress holding a tambourine, large rings of golden sparkles in the sky, diamond-shaped stars, and the dancer's reflection in a pool.

title: I Dedicate to You
description: Two felt lovers lean their heads together, eyes closed, under a huge pale moon. She wears mustard with a red heart, he wears rust, and two coffee cups wait on a small bench.
alt: Needle-felted wool figures of a couple in yellow and rust coats standing head to head in front of a large moon, beside a small bench with two coffee cups.

title: Kintsugi Sunday
description: A woman lounges on a white sofa in a red number 12 jersey, her gray ink skin cracked with gold. Brass cyborg limbs and a gold mechanical eyepiece gleam against the pale room.
alt: Grayscale ink drawing of a woman reclining on a sofa in a red football jersey with the number 12, with gold mechanical arms, legs, and eyepiece.

title: Country Roads
description: A winding road leads home past an apple tree heavy with red fruit, a lone walker on the path. A white farmhouse, a silver river and snow-capped peaks rest under a full moon.
alt: Woodblock-style landscape of a stone path through golden fields beside a tree covered in red apples, with a white farmhouse, a river, snowy mountains, and a full moon.

title: Paisley
description: A dark-haired woman smiles in a cream blouse patterned with burgundy paisley, gold leaf earrings at her ears. Thick knife strokes of teal, lilac and red build the wall behind her.
alt: Impasto painting of a smiling woman with long dark hair, gold drop earrings, and a cream paisley blouse against a patchwork background of teal, lilac, and red.

title: The Glass Jacket
description: A blonde woman smiles softly, tortoiseshell glasses pushed up into her hair. Her pinstripe jacket breaks into jewel-toned stained glass at the lapels, and a teal glow rings her head like a halo.
alt: Portrait of a smiling blonde woman with glasses on her head, gold coin necklaces, and a black pinstripe jacket with stained-glass lapels, against a dark teal background.
